header.name: Group Numbering
header.description: Numbers every top-level group, and each cabinet inside a Kitchen Wizard kitchen - bases then uppers, in order round the room - keeps existing numbers, adds the number to the group name, optional 3D labels.

extension.caption: Group Numbering
extension.description: Number top-level groups and Kitchen Wizard cabinets in order round the room, or remove the 3D number labels. Opens a short list of actions.
